tips.title: Use Project Assistant for creating milling or MillTurn projects
tips.body: Follow step-by-step instructions to create a project in a simple and clear manner.

tips.title: Define job names and comments using patterns
tips.body: Select job parameters to define job or comment names automatically.

tips.title: Use Toolpath quickinfo for job details
tips.body: Quickinfo provides information on frame, job ID, name, comment, type, linked job, tool ID and name.

tips.title: Implement Rollfeed Turning for machine turning parts
tips.body: Roll the tool insert on the component contour by using the Rollfeed Turning cycle.

tips.title: Optimize machining of adaptive pockets with 3D Optimised Roughing
tips.body: Automatic calculation of the lateral infeed based on scallop height and smooth rolling in the pocket area.

tips.title: Use Smooth overlap for slope-dependent machining
tips.body: Optimize surface quality in transition areas between flat and steep areas with small retract movements.

tips.title: Add new coolant types in Tool database
tips.body: Define up to seven additional coolants with unique IDs for postprocessor evaluation.

tips.title: Use Roll turn tool in new Rollfeed Turning cycle
tips.body: Four different insert types are available for optimal rolling of the tool insert on the component contour.

tips.title: Display X/Z setting length for turning tools
tips.body: Improved display of turning tools in the graphics area by showing Setting length x and z.

tips.title: Support COLLISION SAFEGUARD as an external simulation program
tips.body: External simulation supports COLLISION SAFEGUARD for better safety during machine operations.

tips.title: Display rest material in four steps during simulation
tips.body: Rest material is displayed in four steps based on the maximum permissible value.

tips.title: Define NCS position
tips.body: Select 'Basic positions' to use predefined positions relative to the model or stock. Use 'Userdefined' for direct selection in the CAD system.

tips.title: Create machining frames
tips.body: Define global clearance plane height and create orthogonal frames relative to the model or stock.

tips.title: Specify document settings
tips.body: Set units (Metric/Inch), project directories, joblist subdirectories, and global working space.

tips.title: Configure feedback visualisation
tips.body: Set visualisation size, colours for toolpaths and feedback elements.

tips.title: Manage joblist settings
tips.body: Limit maximum number of origins, use global clearance plane, prefer featurelist frame, and enable local cycle parameters.

tips.title: Control toolpath display
tips.body: Display temporary graphics, erase existing toolpaths, update cache automatically, notify changed geometry, and delete temporary files.

tips.title: Preserve reports
tips.body: Save report files in the defined application folder.

tips.title: Check toolpath status
tips.body: Enable geometry check to ensure toolpaths are up-to-date after modifications.

tips.title: Lock elements
tips.body: Disable elements to prevent deletion, geometry change, or attribute change.

tips.title: Set dialogue control mode
tips.body: Enable modal or modeless dialogues and text/icon tabs display.

tips.title: Define NC system
tips.body: The NC system defines the position of the workpiece origin and orientation of machining axes (XYZ). It applies to an entire job list at once.

tips.title: Define Frames
tips.body: Frames define the current machining side and orientation. In multi-axis indexing, a frame must be defined for each machining side.

tips.title: Frame origin coordinates
tips.body: The frame origin coordinates are dependent on the reference system set in the Define Frames dialogue.

tips.title: Clamping position
tips.body: The Clamping position specifies the zero point for simulation, typically at the table upper edge middle point of the machine model.

tips.title: Frame limit for hole features
tips.body: The Frame limit function automatically assigns jobs with hole features to a joblist based on the direction of the hole features.

tips.title: Define an origin
tips.body: An origin can be defined to make accuracy or tolerance corrections for a specific area of the part.

tips.title: Assigning an origin to a job
tips.body: An origin can be assigned to a job by selecting it in the Job definition's Transformation dialogue page.

tips.title: Contour Milling using transformations
tips.body: To machine a contour on multiple sides of a part, define origins and frames for each side and use transformation patterns.

tips.title: Use hyperMILL for generating NC output without switching workplanes
tips.body: hyperMILL allows complete machining of all sides of a cube in a single job by transforming the contour defined on one side to other sides.

tips.title: Set workplane for turning jobs to the current frame/origin
tips.body: Use the 'Set turn workplane' option in hyperMILL to set the workplane for turning jobs.

tips.title: Generate graphical entities for coordinate system display
tips.body: hyperMILL allows generating non-associative CAD elements for the display of the coordinate system, which must be deleted and re-generated when the frame is changed.

tips.title: Use hyperMILL for toolpath reproduction and positioning
tips.body: hyperMILL supports mirrors, linear, circular, and general patterns for toolpath reproduction and positioning to manufacture identical and/or similar workpieces.

tips.title: Define base parameters for transformations in hyperMILL
tips.body: Transformations are defined in two steps: defining base parameters and manufacturing parameters.

tips.title: Define manufacturing parameters for transformations in hyperMILL
tips.body: Manufacturing parameters include start and target references, which specify the coordinate systems used as a basis for relative movement.

tips.title: Use linear pattern in a job, compound job, or linking job
tips.body: A linear pattern can be used to specify the direction of the pattern and structure, such as fixed distance or fit elements.

tips.title: Use circular pattern in a job, compound job, or linking job
tips.body: A circular pattern can be defined by specifying the axis type and pattern layout, such as fit to total angle or fixed step angle.

tips.title: Use general pattern in a job, compound job, or linking job
tips.body: A general pattern can be defined by adding target reference systems and specifying the orientation of the X and Z axes.

tips.title: Move target reference to end of machining sequence
tips.body: Transformations in hyperMILL allow moving the target reference to the end of the machining sequence, enabling programming and subsequent machining in a different location.

tips.title: Support machining with clamping cubes and multiple clamping
tips.body: hyperMILL supports machining with clamping cubes and multiple clamping if the NC data output can be referenced on one common origin (NCS) or one common machining origin.

tips.title: Mirror base geometry for symmetry in machining
tips.body: hyperMILL mirrors the base geometry to achieve symmetric material removal, with options for mirroring on the side of the contour or directly on the contour.

tips.title: Enable Copy option for associativity between original and mirrored jobs
tips.body: Enabling the Copy option in hyperMILL creates a mirrored copy of the original job, which is associated with the original, ensuring all changes are reflected.

tips.title: Mirror stock models for symmetry in machining
tips.body: To mirror a job list that uses a stock model, follow steps to select the mirror plane, enable the Copy option, and define the stock model for the mirror.

tips.title: Define a new mirror transformation in hyperMILL
tips.body: Use the 'New mirror' option on the shortcut menu to define a new mirror transformation.

tips.title: Edit parameters for a selected transformation
tips.body: Click on the appropriate location in the greyed out dialogue with the right mouse button and select 'Edit' to modify the definitions of the currently selected entry.

tips.title: Define a new tool in hyperMILL
tips.body: Switch to the Tools tab and choose 'New > [Tool type]' from the shortcut menu, then define all required parameters in the Edit [tool type] input dialogue.

tips.title: Edit and save document tools in hyperMILL
tips.body: You can edit and save document tools in the document, even if you have not defined a (valid) external database.

tips.title: Define unique ID for each tool
tips.body: Ensure that each tool has a unique ID in the General section of the Edit turning tool dialogue.

tips.title: Select tool type and holder from external database
tips.body: Choose the Tool type and a defined Tool from the external tools database or define new ones.

tips.title: Adjust postprocessor for tool edge and position output
tips.body: Contact your OPEN MIND partner if the position of the cutting edge and position in the NC file need to be output.

tips.title: Use free geometry for collision check
tips.body: Enable the use of free tip geometry for collision checking and simulation in the Free geometry section.

tips.title: Filter tools in external database
tips.body: Use filters to restrict the display of tools by defining conditions in General, Tool, Holder, and Technology sections.

tips.title: Export tools to external database
tips.body: Export tools from hyperMILL browser to the external OPEN MIND tool database by selecting Export to tool database.

tips.title: Unlink tools from external database
tips.body: Unlink tools by selecting Unlink / Unlink all tools from the shortcut menu in the hyperMILL browser.

tips.title: Restore link to external tool database
tips.body: Restore the link to the external database by selecting Relink / Relink all tools from the shortcut menu in the hyperMILL browser.

tips.title: Edit external tool in document
tips.body: Unlink the external NC tool by selecting Status > and make changes in Geometry/Technology fields.

tips.title: Update external tool
tips.body: Update the linked tool with data from the external tool database using Update state / Update all states or Tool/Update all tools.

tips.title: Export tools to XML file
tips.body: Export selected tools or all tools of a document to an XML file using the Export.../Export all... function.

tips.title: Display warning messages for tools
tips.body: View warning messages stored for the tool in the Messages... function.

tips.title: Open job definition with double-click
tips.body: Double-click on a Job ID and Job name to open the corresponding job definition.

tips.title: Set display accuracy for numerical values
tips.body: Adjust the display accuracy for numerical values on the Tools tab of the hyperMILL browser through the external tool database.

tips.title: Select contours for machining
tips.body: Lines, circles, polylines, splines, graphics loaded in omx format (Contour Milling, Pocket Milling and Helical Drilling). Points can be used for drill positions.

tips.title: Generate contours from toolpaths
tips.body: Curves extracted from previously calculated toolpaths can be used both as 2D contours and as help contours for 3D or 5-axis machining.

tips.title: Define stockmodels for machining operations
tips.body: Stockmodels in STL or VIS format can be defined for various machining operations.

tips.title: Collision check for stock models
tips.body: The updated stock model is checked for collisions to ensure both tracked and calculated stock models are collision-free.

tips.title: Define stockmodels using various methods
tips.body: Methods include Extrusion, Rotation, Surfaces, From job, File, Bounding geometry, and Cast offset.

tips.title: Select reference job for stock model update
tips.body: A reference job can be selected to define a stockmodel based on its closed stockmodel.

tips.title: Set workplane for STL files
tips.body: For STL files created using the Geometric Engine or hyperCAD, set the workplane to WKS before saving.

tips.title: Define turning stock from existing stockmodel
tips.body: A turning stock can be created from an existing milling stockmodel or file.

tips.title: Select frame for turning axis
tips.body: The frame of the joblist or job is used by default, but another frame can be selected or a new one defined.

tips.title: Calculate stockmodel for turning jobs
tips.body: A stockmodel can be calculated for turning jobs based on the current polyhedron or a bounding geometry.

tips.title: Generate cast stockmodels for turning jobs
tips.body: Cast stockmodels are always created in *.vis format.

tips.title: Define stockmodels using STL or VIS files
tips.body: Select a file in *.STL or *.VIS format and use the Stock option to select an existing stockmodel from the list.

tips.title: Set global offset for stockmodels
tips.body: Select the Global offset option if the offset is to apply to the entire stockmodel.

tips.title: Create compound stock for multiple components
tips.body: Right-click the stock browser and select New compound stock to merge separate stockmodels into one.

tips.title: Edit stock by splitting or cleaning
tips.body: Select the Edit stock function to split or clean selected stockmodel into new entries.

tips.title: Create stock chain for job sequences
tips.body: Select jobs and use the Stock > Create stock chain function to generate stock models based on preceding tool-paths.

tips.title: Mirror stock models for symmetry
tips.body: Select the Mirror stock function to create mirrored versions of selected stockmodels.

tips.title: Transform stock models for orientation changes
tips.body: Select the New stock through transformation function to generate new stockmodels by rotating or scaling existing ones.

tips.title: Calculate stock models for machining operations
tips.body: Select the Calculate function to update or calculate stockmodels based on current tool-paths.

tips.title: Display rest material for stock models
tips.body: Select the Rest material display function to visualize the remaining material in selected stockmodels.

tips.title: Save stock models in VIS format
tips.body: Select the Save stock file as function and choose *.VIS format for high-accuracy stockmodels.

tips.title: Define a joblist for organizing CAM projects
tips.body: A joblist is the uppermost administration level in hyperMILL's job browser, containing multiple jobs and sub-jobs.

tips.title: Create a new job in hyperMILL
tips.body: To create a new job, switch to the Jobs tab and right-click > select Job.

tips.title: Export a joblist with all parameters and settings
tips.body: To export a joblist, select the joblist and choose Export from the shortcut menu. Specify export options and file location.

tips.title: Import a joblist into another CAD model
tips.body: To import a joblist, use the New > Load from file function and select the *.jst file. Enable required import options.

tips.title: Define joblist settings before calculating toolpaths
tips.body: Settings for a joblist can be defined separately and must be made before calculating the toolpaths.

tips.title: Specify the program zero point for toolpaths
tips.body: You must specify the programme zero point before creating the toolpath to avoid invalidating previously created toolpaths.

tips.title: Allow multiple origins for machining
tips.body: Select the 'Allow multiple origins' option if you require multiple origins for machining, such as on different sides of a cube.

tips.title: Define stock models for multiple jobs
tips.body: A stock model is a definition available for multiple jobs in a joblist, used for visualizing model data in hyperVIEW.

tips.title: Define milling areas for multiple jobs
tips.body: A milling area is a definition available for multiple jobs in a joblist, used for visualizing model data in hyperVIEW.

tips.title: Select material for machining purposes
tips.body: The default option is 'Defined' when creating a new job list, and you can select the required material from the list.

tips.title: Assign a clamping area to a joblist or define a new one
tips.body: Click the icon to define a new clamping area, and assign it to a joblist or define a new clamping area.

tips.title: Define a mirror for all jobs/compound jobs in the job list
tips.body: Select the respective checkbox in the Active line and under Selection choose the mirror you require.

tips.title: Set NC file naming method in joblist settings
tips.body: Enable and select the method for naming the NC files (Single mode / Package mode) under the NC file name section.

tips.title: Use document settings for NC directory in joblist settings
tips.body: Enable the 'Use document settings' option if the NC directory is selected to apply document settings to the NC directory.

tips.title: Define a rule for filename generation in joblist settings
tips.body: As standard, the file name of the NC file is composed of the following elements: Jobname_Job ID.

tips.title: Enable vector fine interpolation for smoother toolpaths
tips.body: Vector fine interpolation is enabled by default in hyperMILL to control machine movements during vector changes.

tips.title: Optimize rapid tool movements for smoother and faster machining
tips.body: Select the 'optimised' option in the Rapid mode to avoid pole passes and high acceleration of the C axis during 5X machining.

tips.title: Create a new job using the New function on the browser's shortcut menu
tips.body: To create a new job, use the 'New' function on the browser's shortcut menu and specify required settings on all dialogue pages.

tips.title: Transfer parameters of a job definition to another job
tips.body: Use the Copy and Paste functions on the shortcut menu to transfer parameters between jobs, ignoring logically untransferrable parameters.

tips.title: Define job-specific details for identification and display purposes
tips.body: In the 'General' dialogue page, define job name, comment, ID, and use name patterns for jobs and comments.

tips.title: Configure colours for tool feedback display
tips.body: Use global colour definitions from the hyperMILL settings dialogue or configure colours for rapid, infeed, collision, and tool axis movements.

tips.title: Enter user-defined text blocks in the NC dialogue
tips.body: Use the 'NC' function to enter user-defined text blocks such as control instructions or other similar parameters, ensuring the machine can interpret the data correctly.

tips.title: Define a compound job to structure joblists clearly
tips.body: Combine any 2D, 3D or 5X jobs into a compound job for better organization and management.

tips.title: Define a linking job for optimized approach and retract movements
tips.body: A linking job optimizes and monitors collisions during the entire machining sequence and between individual jobs.

tips.title: Combine multiple jobs into a linking job with specific conditions
tips.body: To combine multiple jobs into a linking job, ensure all sub-jobs use the same tool and meet other specified requirements.

tips.title: Linking of 3D and 5-axis jobs
tips.body: It is possible to link the 2D cycles Pocket Milling and Rest Machining in 5X mode.

tips.title: Specify the mode for the fast travel movements (rapids)
tips.body: Skip first and last: Skip the first infeed movement and last retract movement of the individual sub-jobs.

tips.title: Clearance mode for linking job turning
tips.body: Planar / Radial: Specify how the toolpaths of the linked sub-jobs are linked.

tips.title: Clearance radius X for rapid tool movements in the X direction
tips.body: Clearance radius X: radius for rapid tool movements in the X direction (1).

tips.title: Clearance plane Z for rapid tool movements in the Z direction
tips.body: Clearance plane Z: plane for rapid tool movements in the Z direction (2).

tips.title: Clearance distance for linking movements
tips.body: Clearance distance: distance from the tool to the workpiece in the X direction during linking movements (3).

tips.title: Rapid smoothing for Clearance distance retract mode
tips.body: Enable the High speed option to activate Rapid smoothing (1).

tips.title: Transformation for linking jobs
tips.body: The current transformation is executed by calculating the linking job and all copies are linked to collision-checked rapid link movements.

tips.title: NC events for structuring the program flow
tips.body: Use NC events to clearly structure the program flow and influence programming by entering commands, joblists and jobs.

tips.title: Multi-Axis Indexing prerequisites
tips.body: A machine with C axis and/or swivelling milling head (5-axis machining). A drawing in the form of a 3D model.

tips.title: Defining machine cycles in a job sequence
tips.body: The job sequence is basically arbitrary.

tips.title: Tool change optimization by sorting jobs
tips.body: Sort by tool: Starting with the first tool in the expanded joblist, the jobs are sorted by tool number in ascending order.

tips.title: Global editing for multiple jobs
tips.body: Edit job definition parameters for multiple jobs at the same time.

tips.title: Creating an associative job copy
tips.body: Select the job in the joblist, right-click and select the Associative job copy function from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Unlink associative job copy
tips.body: Right-click relevant parameter and select Unlink to deactivate the associative link between the original job and the associative job copy.

tips.title: Create associative job copy
tips.body: Use the Associative job copy function to create an associative job copy from the currently selected job.

tips.title: Edit job parameters
tips.body: Select jobs to edit and modify parameters together using Global editing if multiple jobs are selected.

tips.title: Create stock chain
tips.body: Use the Create stock chain function to create a stock chain for selected jobs, creating a stock object for each job.

tips.title: Update stock models
tips.body: Recalculate stock models for selected jobs using the Update function on the Jobs shortcut menu or the Calculate function on the shortcut menu for the stockmodel entry.

tips.title: Calculate toolpath file
tips.body: Use the Calculate function to calculate the toolpath file for selected entries (job/joblist).

tips.title: Generate NC file
tips.body: Perform a postprocessor run for selected entries (job/joblist) using the Generate NC file function.

tips.title: Start internal simulation
tips.body: Use the Internal simulation function to start an internal simulation of the job.

tips.title: Start machine simulation
tips.body: Use the Internal machine simulation function to start a machine simulation of the job.

tips.title: Show toolpaths
tips.body: Use the Show / Hide / Autoshow options to control the visibility of toolpaths in the Toolpath Edit cycle.

tips.title: Check model consistency
tips.body: Use the Check model function to verify the consistency of contours assigned to a job.

tips.title: Define milling area
tips.body: Use the Define milling area function to set the area of the CAD model to be machined and checked for collisions.

tips.title: Exclude areas from machining
tips.body: Inside the milling area, exclude areas from machining using stop surfaces or other methods.

tips.title: Define turning area
tips.body: Open hyperMILL browser, go to Jobs tab, select Collision check option, and define contour, frame for turning axis, surfaces, and resolution.

tips.title: Define clamping area
tips.body: Open hyperMILL browser, go to Jobs tab, select Part data tab, select Defined option, and define surfaces or file for fixture.

tips.title: Set allowance
tips.body: Define the height of the allowance that will be used in cycles with multiple allowances.

tips.title: Collision check preparations
tips.body: Ensure all entries in the Milling Area dialogue box are made correctly before calculating a job to create a 3DF file.

tips.title: Define fixture area
tips.body: Specify a name and comment for the fixture, set file settings, and manage entries using standard Windows functions.

tips.title: Use hyperMILL Converter
tips.body: Start the Converter from the hyperMILL menu, select storage location for 3DF file, set resolution, and choose selection options.

tips.title: Set mathematical resolution for conversion
tips.body: Specify the maximum chordal height and surface resolution based on operation type (roughing, finishing, HSC machining).

tips.title: Limit facet length
tips.body: Control the maximum facet length within the 3DF model, defining it for each group in group definitions.

tips.title: Avoid using certain tools for collision check
tips.body: Collision checks against the defined clamping area are not supported for jobs with Chamfered Cutter, T-Slot Cutter, Woodruff Cutter, Barrel Cutter, Turning Tool, Recessing Tool, Axial Recessing Tool, and Threading Tool.

tips.title: Define groups for different machining areas
tips.body: Select areas with different resolutions and stock allowances to define collision and protected areas. Coarse resolution for roughing, finer for fine machining.

tips.title: Set job sequence for correct machining order
tips.body: Ensure the sequence of jobs in the job list matches the desired machining order.

tips.title: Check job definitions for errors before calculating toolpaths
tips.body: Review jobs with error or warning notifications using the Messages function on the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Define milling area for 3D and 5-axis machining
tips.body: A milling area must be present to calculate a toolpath in 3D and 5-axis operations.

tips.title: Set system of units for toolpath calculation
tips.body: The measurement system set during job definition is valid for the toolpath calculation and cannot be changed afterward.

tips.title: Configure job-specific settings for toolpaths
tips.body: Set the name and path of toolpaths, NCS (program zero point), original stock, model, and postprocessor-specific settings.

tips.title: Calculate toolpaths directly in job definition or browser
tips.body: Toolpaths can be calculated either directly in the job definition for individual jobs or using the hyperMILL browser.

tips.title: Edit job settings during toolpath calculation
tips.body: During the calculation, edit job settings via the Job/Joblist dialogue or shortcut menu.

tips.title: Cancel or stop toolpath calculation during process
tips.body: Control the calculation by canceling, stopping, or continuing from the message window.

tips.title: Display toolpaths continuously in CAD file
tips.body: If specified, generated toolpaths are added to the CAD file during calculation.

tips.title: Identify and display collisions during toolpath calculation
tips.body: Collisions are displayed graphically while calculating the toolpaths.

tips.title: Update calculated toolpaths for changes in feedrate or spindle RPM
tips.body: Changes to feedrate, spindle RPM, or comment do not require a full recalculation for certain cycles.

tips.title: Change spindle RPM or feedrate for a job
tips.body: Modify the value directly on the Tool tab of the job definition or in the Technology tab of the tool definition.

tips.title: Read toolpaths for job or purposes of analyses
tips.body: Distinguish between reading toolpaths for a job and for general analyses.

tips.title: Configure information displayed on hyperCAD menu
tips.body: Customize the information shown in the tooltip via File > Options > Tooltip content.

tips.title: Use Toolpath Edit cycle for safe toolpath modifications
tips.body: Delete sections in calculated toolpaths using a boundary and link remaining parts, automatically checking for collisions.

tips.title: Use minimum distance G0 to avoid unnecessary rapid link movements
tips.body: Set a minimum distance for G0 movements to enhance process safety and reduce machine running time.

tips.title: Select job to edit and use boundary for toolpath editing
tips.body: To edit toolpaths using a boundary, select the job in hyperMILL Browser and choose New > Toolpath edit.

tips.title: Simulate machining using hyperVIEW, internal simulation, or external programs
tips.body: Options include hyperVIEW, internal simulation with machine models, and external simulation software like VERICUT.

tips.title: Check toolpaths for collisions using machine models in internal machine simulation
tips.body: All registered machine models and their kinematics are considered during collision checks.

tips.title: Stop simulation at collision if enabled and collision check is on
tips.body: The simulation will stop as soon as the first collision is detected, with colliding components highlighted in red.

tips.title: Simulate complete material removal for machining steps
tips.body: Use the material removal simulation to simulate complete material removal based on the current stock model.

tips.title: Activate fast stock calculation for large models
tips.body: Enable the Fast stock calculation option to accelerate stock model generation, especially for large models.

tips.title: Calculate missing stock models before material removal simulation
tips.body: Define jobs to calculate for which no resulting stock model was calculated, and use them as starting stock models.

tips.title: Display rest material after machining
tips.body: Highlight the job in the list, select Utilities > Rest material display from the shortcut menu, and define stock model for display.

tips.title: Configure rest material display parameters
tips.body: Set Allowance, Max. rest material, and Model tesselation in the Rest material display dialogue.

tips.title: Measure distances and angles in CAD
tips.body: Left-click to select points or surfaces, then left-click again for the second point. Results include angle, surface distance, and point distance.

tips.title: Enable machine cone shape interpolation in simulation
tips.body: Open Machine structure dialogue, enable 'Enable machine cone shape interpolation' for vector jumps.

tips.title: Configure collision checks during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup collision check dialogue, specify elements to check (Tool, Holder, Model), and enable automatic adjust for tailstock.

tips.title: Define cutting length for performance improvement
tips.body: Enable stock checks and set tolerance, head offset/fixture, and check always non-cutting area in the Setup simulation dialogue.

tips.title: Change tool definition during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, change tool parameters (e.g., tool length), and select 'Tool from job' for the tool mode.

tips.title: Set up simulation parameters
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, set Simulation tolerance and Tool mode (Tool from job or Tool from tool list).

tips.title: Display toolpaths during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, enable 'Display toolpaths' to show or hide the current toolpath.

tips.title: Fix machine during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, enable 'Fix machine' to move the model during the simulation.

tips.title: Simulate only NC jobs
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, enable 'Simulate only NC jobs' to activate simulations for previously created NC files.

tips.title: Define job colours for simulation display
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, enable 'Use job colours' to show material removal in job-specific colours.

tips.title: Adjust tool length during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, enable 'Allow to adjust tool length' for shortened or extended tool display.

tips.title: Display elements transparently during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, enable options for transparent display of model, fixture, stockmodel, and machine.

tips.title: Switch collision check on during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, enable 'Switches the collision check on' to check elements activated in the Setup collision check dialogue.

tips.title: Define workspace during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup simulation dialogue, define workspace parameters (Max. start and end points, Defined workspace, Current position of the tool).

tips.title: Set up collision check and machine structure
tips.body: For detailed instructions, refer to section Simulation Control.

tips.title: Align tool at frame or surface normal
tips.body: Use left mouse button to position the tool anywhere in the CAD model.

tips.title: Change tool position based on coordinate system or frame
tips.body: Adjust the accuracy using the increment value.

tips.title: Optimize tool length automatically
tips.body: hyperMILL calculates the optimum tool length for any tool position.

tips.title: Display surface errors using Converter
tips.body: Surface errors are displayed on the Visibility > TAGs > Converter tab.

tips.title: Export and import geometry data using OMX format
tips.body: Transfer geometry data between job lists using Export OMX and Import OMX.

tips.title: Import WinTool tools into hyperMILL
tips.body: Automatically assigns NC numbers to imported tools.

tips.title: Export Zoller tools from hyperMILL
tips.body: Creates a usage list for each joblist if the document contains multiple joblists.

tips.title: Offset contours for machining area boundary settings
tips.body: Change the size of boundaries and select surface edges to offset them.

tips.title: Link adjacent contours that do not meet exactly
tips.body: System trims minor overlaps and closes small gaps within the specified tolerance.

tips.body: Define the geometric elements (curve/surface) with which you want to generate a boundary.

tips.body: You can generate either a Strategy feature (boundary/profile) or a Contour feature (2D/3D) from the selected boundary.

tips.body: Enable collision check to permanently verify potential collisions between the tool and stockmodel.
