tips.body: Generate a turning area by selecting a closed contour, defining the frame, colour, and layer.

tips.title: Define turning stock from model
tips.body: Generate a turning stock based on the current turning job or combine milling and turning jobs.

tips.title: Create milling stock from turning stock
tips.body: Any turning stock in the hyperMILL model browser can be used to create a milling stockmodel.

tips.title: Select machining strategy for contours
tips.body: Machining is performed perpendicular to the axis of the turning surface.

tips.title: Define infeed direction for contours
tips.body: Machining can be performed from right to left or from left to right, with central option starting at plunge point.

tips.title: Set radial and axial infeed parameters
tips.body: Axial infeed (cutting depth) and maximum depth of material removal in radial direction.

tips.title: Define dwell time for tool
tips.body: Specify dwell time in revolutions of the model or time units.

tips.title: Configure pecking for efficient chip removal
tips.body: Tool plunges by defined plunge depth and retracts by retract value in alternating manner until total radial infeed is reached.

tips.title: Define clearance plane for rapid tool movements
tips.body: Plane for rapid tool movements in the Z direction, available for Inside machining and Plane options.

tips.title: Configure approach and retract macros
tips.body: Additional movement during each infeed, define ramp angle and length for Approach/Retract macros.

tips.title: Define stock trimming for right and left sides
tips.body: Stock trimming can be defined separately for the right and left sides, using axial or tangential methods.

tips.title: Enable collision check
tips.body: Select option to permanently check the tool holder for potential collisions against stockmodel and turning model.

tips.title: Specify turning area name and comment
tips.body: Open Turning area dialogue, enter a name and optional comment.

tips.title: Select surfaces or solids for turning area
tips.body: hyperMILL automatically creates a turning contour from selected surfaces or solids.

tips.title: Define turning stock model
tips.body: Create a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame and associated axis.

tips.title: Specify turning stock name and comment
tips.body: Open Stock dialogue, enter a name and optional comment.

tips.title: Generate turning stock from current job
tips.body: Create a stockmodel for subsequent jobs based on the current turning job.

tips.title: Define contour for turning operations
tips.body: Specify contours that may correspond to the turning model.

tips.title: Reverse machining direction
tips.body: Invert the machining direction of a selected contour.

tips.title: Assign cutting speed and feedrate to contour segments
tips.body: Edit segments to assign values manually or based on factors.

tips.title: Enable automatic corner brake
tips.body: Round or chamfer sharp corners of a contour automatically.

tips.title: Define radial and axial limits
tips.body: Limit machining area in the radial or axial direction.

tips.title: Enable path compensation
tips.body: Handle path compensation by the controller for better tool wear and surface quality.

tips.title: Define model and additional allowances
tips.body: Set global and additional allowances on the model in Z, X directions.

tips.title: Set ramp angle for smooth connections
tips.body: Define the turning axis and infeed direction for a smooth connection.

tips.title: Define tangential approach and retract macros
tips.body: Set additional options for smooth connections during finishing.

tips.title: Define a turning model
tips.body: Create a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame.

tips.title: Specify turning area details
tips.body: Name and comment the turning area, define frame, colour, and layer.

tips.title: Define turning stock details
tips.body: Create a closed, planar contour in the X-Z plane of the turning frame and associated turning axis.

tips.title: Generate stock models for subsequent jobs
tips.body: Create stockmodels for turning or milling based on the current job.

tips.title: Select machining frame for turning axis
tips.body: Ensure the Z-axis of the machining frame matches the rotary axis of the tool.

tips.title: Define infeed direction for turning operations
tips.body: Choose 'Bottom' or 'Top' based on the direction to the axis of the turning stock.

tips.title: Set cutting mode for turning operations
tips.body: Choose 'Oneway' or 'Zigzag' based on the orientation requirement.

tips.title: Define radial infeed for turning operations
tips.body: Set the maximum depth of material removal in the radial direction.

tips.title: Specify dwell time for tool movements
tips.body: Set the dwell time in revolutions or seconds.

tips.title: Set macro clearance for tool movements
tips.body: Define the minimum distance of the tool to the turning area during approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Define clearance radius for rapid movements
tips.body: Set the radius for rapid tool movements in the X direction.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for rapid movements
tips.body: Define the plane for rapid tool movements in the Z direction.

tips.title: Define model allowance for turning operations
tips.body: Set global and additional allowances in X and Z directions.

tips.title: Set axial compensation value for tool movements
tips.body: Define the axial deviation from the model contour due to tool deflection.

tips.title: Increase retraction feedrate for specific machining strategies
tips.body: Enable this option to increase the retraction feedrate for strategies without ramp movements.

tips.title: Define cutting side for face groove plunging
tips.body: Choose 'Inside' or 'Outside' based on the external or internal shape of the workpiece.

tips.title: Set infeed direction for face groove plunging
tips.body: Choose 'Bottom', 'Top', or 'Central' based on the direction to the axis of the turning stock.

tips.title: Set radial and axial limits
tips.body: Limits the machining area of the tool in radial and axial directions to avoid undercutting areas.

tips.title: Configure retract plane (Z)
tips.body: Activates the Radial / Axial limit option in combination with Retract plane (Z) to drive out the tool from undercutting areas.

tips.title: Define infeed parameters
tips.body: Set radial infeed, max. infeed depth, and axial depth for material removal.

tips.title: Specify dwell time
tips.body: Set the dwell time of the tool using revolutions or time units.

tips.title: Configure pecking method
tips.body: Plunge and retract the tool in alternating manner until total radial infeed is reached to remove chips efficiently.

tips.title: Set clearance parameters
tips.body: Define macro clearance, clearance distance, and clearance radius for approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Define stock trimming options
tips.body: Set stock trimming for the right and left sides separately, either axial or tangential.

tips.title: Configure machining mode
tips.body: Limit machining to selected areas by separating flat and steep areas with a slope angle.

tips.title: Set axial offset parameters
tips.body: Pre-plunge the tool at the transition of the defined contour to prevent engaging with two sides simultaneously.

tips.title: Define type of cut
tips.body: Material is removed with up and down movements for vertical walls or downward movements only.

tips.title: Set overlap parameter
tips.body: A path overlap to avoid collision with perpendicular walls, value should be slightly larger than the tool radius.

tips.title: Set model allowance for turning operations
tips.body: Model allowance (1): Global allowance on the model.

tips.title: Define additional allowances for X and Z directions
tips.body:
Additional allowance X (2): Allowance in X direction.
Additional allowance Z (3): Allowance in Z direction.

tips.title: Create turning area from a closed contour
tips.body: Generate a turning area by selecting a closed contour.

tips.title: Define frame for turning axis
tips.body: Select a frame for the turning axis from the list.

tips.title: Set resolution for turning area
tips.body: Resolution: Define the resolution (fineness) of the turning area.

tips.title: Set reference side for parting tool
tips.body: Reference side: The insert side that is used as a reference to calculate the toolpath can either be left or right.

tips.title: Define parting strategy based on tool position
tips.body: The machining strategy is determined by the parting tool definition.

tips.title: Enable chamfer creation at trailing edge
tips.body: With chamfer: enable when a chamfer is to be created at the trailing edge of the model and define the desired chamfer dimension.

tips.title: Define parting off and rapid retraction
tips.body: Parting off and rapid (1): a retraction movement is performed at feedrate in Z direction to clearance distance, then rapid retract to the clearance radius.

tips.title: Set pecking parameters for multiple passes
tips.body: Plunge depth (1): tool infeed per parting motion.

tips.title: Define additional allowance for Z direction on parting side
tips.body: Additional allowance Z (3): Additional allowance in Z direction on the parting side of the tool.

tips.title: Generate turning stock from existing mill stock
tips.body: Select base stock and create a milling stockmodel for subsequent jobs.

tips.title: Set machining direction for threads
tips.body: Enable left thread or internal thread for specific requirements.

tips.title: Define thread outer edge
tips.body: Select a contour and specify if it's the core diameter or nominal diameter.

tips.title: Set infeed strategy for threads
tips.body: Choose from one cut, constant chip section, or constant X infeed.

tips.title: Define drilling strategy
tips.body: Select drilling mode (2D, 2D multi-axis) and define contours for holes.

tips.title: Set drilling mode for 2D multi-axis
tips.body: Align drill holes with different frames/planes and define relative clearance.

tips.title: Use centering for drilling
tips.body: Enable centrings with various parameters to improve accuracy.

tips.title: Set drilling mode for turning jobs
tips.body: Use Turning mode for jobs with a rotating spindle.

tips.title: Set drilling direction with frame system
tips.body: In Drilling mode, the frame specifies the machining direction. In 5X Drilling mode, several sides can be machined simultaneously.

tips.title: Select drill positions using contours or features
tips.body: Drill positions can be selected directly on the Contours input page or by allocating a previously defined feature on the Feature input page.

tips.title: Define drill hole parameters
tips.body: Parameters include diameter, additional distance (clearance), and depth.

tips.title: Optimize drilling points for even stress distribution
tips.body: Drilling point optimisation allows optimization based on criteria like shortest distance or circular segments.

tips.title: Set orientation for drilling points
tips.body: Orientation can be set to clockwise, counterclockwise, or zigzag.

tips.title: Define segment width for parallel drilling strategies
tips.body: Segment width defines the maximum distance between points in the X or Y direction within a segment.

tips.title: Set maximum segment gap for contour parallel drilling
tips.body: Max. segment gap defines the value of the maximum distance between two subareas on the same surface.

tips.title: Set maximum drilling point gap
tips.body: Max. drilling point gap: Value of the maximum possible distance between two drilling points (P1, P2). If two drilling points are located within this limit, machining is carried out directly from P1 to P2 or vice versa.

tips.title: Optimize drilling strategy for 5X Drilling
tips.body: Two different optimisation methods are available for 5-axis drilling: Frame view and Grouping.

tips.title: Control grouping of drill holes for 5X Drilling
tips.body: Move B axis first / Move C axis first: Control the grouping of drill holes and thus specify the machining sequence.

tips.title: Define machining areas for drilling
tips.body: Define the machining areas (in addition to definitions on the Contours dialogue page), the infeed and clearance parameters plus other machining parameters.

tips.title: Set retract distance for drilling
tips.body: Retract distance: Dimension of the axial distance between the top of the drill hole and the retract movement to the clearance plane.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for drilling
tips.body: Clearance plane: The J:Ft variable sets the Clearance plane for all drilling cycles to the height of the highest selected feature relevant for machining.

tips.title: Enable Rapid smoothing for 5X Drilling
tips.body: Enable the High speed option to activate Rapid smoothing.

tips.title: Set stop surfaces for drilling
tips.body: Stop surfaces: Limit the depth of your drill hole using stop surfaces.

tips.title: Set pecking depth for drilling with Chip Beak
tips.body: Pecking depth (1): Stepdown of the tool in the first drilling stroke.

tips.title: Set retraction distance for drilling with Chip Beak
tips.body: Retract distance (2): Rapid retraction of the tool for each drilling stroke.

tips.title: Set feedrate for retraction in tapping
tips.body: Feedrate retract (1): Enter feedrate for retraction.

tips.title: Use intermediate depth for pre-drilled holes
tips.body: Intermediate depth: Depth of a pre-drilled hole. Rapid, Feedrate.

tips.title: Define spindle RPM for drilling operations
tips.body: Spindle RPM: Define the spindle RPM for roughing, finishing and the slots area.

tips.title: Use chamfer length for toolpath calculation
tips.body: Chamfer length: The chamfer length of the tool is taken into account when calculating the toolpath.

tips.title: Set feedrate for helical drilling
tips.body: Feedrate: Define the feedrate for roughing, finishing and the slots area.

tips.title: Select tool for thread milling
tips.body: You can use ball mills, end mills, bullnose end mills and thread mills.

tips.title: Set thread parameters for milling
tips.body: Parameters: Thread starts, Number of cuts, Conic angle.

tips.title: Use compensated centre path for toolpath calculation
tips.body: Compensated centre path: hyperMILL calculates a toolpath that can be machined using the specified tool without collisions.

tips.title: Set approach and retract radius for circular pocket
tips.body: Approach radius/retract radius: Enter the corresponding radii.

tips.title: Adjust feedrate/spindle speed manually for drilling phases
tips.body: To manually adjust a value for Feedrate / Spindle speed: Select the line, right-click the Feedrate / Spindle speed column and select the Unlink option.

tips.title: Use negative spindle speed for specific sections in drilling
tips.body: When using a negative spindle speed or 0, the system checks of the postprocessor is prepared for this.

tips.title: Define guide sleeve length
tips.body: Set the length of the guide sleeve used for accurate drilling guidance.

tips.title: Enable coolant off in crosshole
tips.body: Switch off coolant at the start of crosshole drilling and turn it back on at the end.

tips.title: Set coolant point of on for pilot hole
tips.body: Enable the Lead in option when machining with a pilot hole.

tips.title: Set coolant point of off during retract
tips.body: Switch off coolant during the retract movement at specified distances.

tips.title: Define collision checked part of the model
tips.body: Set the collision checked part of the CAD model for drilling operations.

tips.title: Set additional safety surfaces for drilling
tips.body: Define temporary safety surfaces to avoid unnecessary rapid travel movements.

tips.title: Stop tool before execution with marker
tips.body: Use a stop marker in the toolpath to cause the tool to stop during simulation and execution.

tips.title: Define clearance straighten angle for helical drilling
tips.body: Set the angle at which the tool turns to achieve clearance during helical drilling.

tips.title: Set clearance feedrate for helical drilling
tips.body: Define the feedrate for linking movements between machining areas in the clearance distance.

tips.title: Define machining area for drilling
tips.body: Specify the offset top, bottom offset, and break through length for helical drilling.

tips.title: Set pitch height for helical drilling
tips.body: Define the pitch of the spiral-shaped path in helical drilling mode.

tips.title: Set reposition feedrate for helical drilling
tips.body: Define the feedrate of the tool during repositioning between infeed planes.

tips.title: Set tilt angle for helical drilling
tips.body: Define the tool axis angle to the Z axis of the frame in use.

tips.title: Set lead angle for helical drilling
tips.body: Define the angle by which the tool is tilted in the infeed direction.

tips.title: Set hole collision avoidance parameters
tips.body: Define the tilt angle max. range and lead angle for collision avoidance around the A/B axis.

tips.title: Define machining contours and cycle-specific parameters
tips.body: Select points, arcs, circles, reference lines, curves, and surfaces for machining.

tips.title: Set top and bottom parameters for contours
tips.body: Define the start of machining in Z direction (top) and end depth of machining in Z direction (bottom). Both can be absolute or relative values.

tips.title: Use different infeed modes for T-slot cutting
tips.body: Choose from various axial infeed modes to define Z infeed freely during T-slot cutting.

tips.title: Define clearance parameters for rapid travel movements
tips.body: Set the clearance plane and clearance distance for fast travel movements along all three axes.

tips.title: Use approach and retract macros for all 2D milling cycles except face milling
tips.body: Define macros for approach, retract, and plunge movements to control toolpath behavior.

tips.title: Automatically recognize rest material areas for pocket milling
tips.body: Rest material recognition applies to machining with one contour in Absolute (jobframe) mode.

tips.title: Ensure tool contact with model geometry on one side during pocket milling
tips.body: The tool diameter must not correspond exactly with the model geometry to be machined.

tips.title: Use geometric information from Pocket feature as contours
tips.body: Geometric data from the Pocket feature can be used for contour milling.

tips.title: Define open areas in pocket milling
tips.body: Select start point, end point and a further point on the contour to define open areas.

tips.title: Use plunge point for pocket milling
tips.body: Define a plunge point either globally or separately for each pocket.

tips.title: Automatic plunge point selection
tips.body: The software automatically selects the optimal starting point for machining pocket contours.

tips.title: Define plunge point outside pocket
tips.body: If the plunge point is outside the pocket contour, the tool moves into the pocket along the shortest path (G1).

tips.title: Sort contours for optimal traversal
tips.body: Select the option to sort contours according to the shortest distance between them.

tips.title: Select machining mode
tips.body: Choose between 2D, 3D, or Stock mode based on the machining requirements.

tips.title: Specify climb milling or conventional milling
tips.body: Select climb milling for clockwise rotating tools and conventional milling for anticlockwise rotating tools.

tips.title: Enable adaptive pocket for optimized machining
tips.body: Optimize machining of rectangular and circular pockets with islands.

tips.title: Adjust feedrates and infeed for adaptive pockets
tips.body: Define parameters for adjusting feedrates and infeed under full cut behaviour conditions.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for retraction
tips.body: The tool retracts to the clearance plane after each plane has been machined.

tips.title: Adjust lead-in keep position
tips.body: The tool plunges to the next deepest plane at the current position after each machined plane.

tips.title: Enable High Performance Mode
tips.body: Select the check box for High Performance Mode to optimize machining time and rate.

tips.title: Adjust opening cut parameters
tips.body: Enable the opening cut function and adjust vertical stepdown and feedrate for specific machining situations.

tips.title: Set entry feedrate for opening cut
tips.body: Adjust the lateral approach from outside and reference to the feedrate XY of the tool.

tips.title: Adjust plunge entry for opening cut
tips.body: Affects the helical or ramp plunge into the material from above.

tips.title: Set zigzag feedrate
tips.body: Reduce the opposite direction feedrate by a specified factor for climb milling.

tips.title: Enable High Performance Mode restrictions
tips.body: Corner fillet radius must be greater than 0.05* tool diameter, and core diameter must be smaller than the flat part of the tool.

tips.title: Disable plunge points in High Performance Mode
tips.body: Plunge points are not supported in High Performance Mode.

tips.title: Disable Use adaptive pocket in High Performance Mode
tips.body: The Use adaptive pocket option is not available in High Performance Mode.

tips.title: Disable G2/G3 movements in High Performance Mode
tips.body: No G2/G3 movements can be generated in the 3D Mode.

tips.title: Enable fillet all toolpaths by default
tips.body: Fillet all toolpaths is enabled by default.

tips.title: Disable Radius for horizontal infeed
tips.body: The Radius for horizontal infeed parameter is not available.

tips.title: Limit negative stock allowance XY
tips.body: Negative stock allowance XY must not be greater than 0.25 * tool diameter in the 2D mode / Stock mode.

tips.title: Set retract mode to retraction plane
tips.body: The retract mode is set to retraction plane.

tips.title: Use Ramp or Helical plunge macro
tips.body: Only the Ramp or Helical plunge macro is available as a macro.

tips.title: Calculate helix radius automatically
tips.body: The helix radius of the cycle is calculated automatically when using the Helical plunge macro.

tips.title: Angle must be greater than 0.01
tips.body: The angle for the Helical plunge macro must be greater than 0.01.

tips.title: Define approach, retract, and plunge macros for tool movement
tips.body: Approach macro: Perpendicular (length), Circular (arc radius). Retract macro: None (Z direction), Perpendicular (contour tangent), Circular (arc radius). Plunge macro: Tool movement for stepdown to the next work plane. Not available in stock mode.

tips.title: Use vertical plunge macro for specific conditions
tips.body: For stepdown without material removal, soft materials, existing predrilled holes, and vertical plunging with a suitable tool.

tips.title: Configure helical plunge macro for pocket milling
tips.body: Helical (B): Use to clear pockets without pre-drilling. Helix radius: Offset of the cutter centre point relative to the axis of the helix. Angle: Lead angle of the helix.

tips.title: Set up tool contour milling parameters
tips.body: Tool types: ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, chamfered cutter, T-slot cutter. Contours must be Polylines, Circles, Ellipses, or Splines.

tips.title: Adjust feedrate for individual contour elements
tips.body: Options: Centre (standard), Edge control, Segments. Assign feedrate to segments using Edit segments button.

tips.title: Select tool position for contour milling
tips.body: Left (path compensation), Right (path compensation), On contour (no path compensation). Centre path: hyperMILL calculates a collision-free toolpath.

tips.title: Configure compensated centre path for tool compensation
tips.body: Compensated centre path: hyperMILL calculates a collision-free toolpath including path compensation. Max. compensation value: Tool radius * 0.01 or Nominal diameter * 0.01.

tips.title: Set infeed method for contour milling
tips.body: Vertical stepdown: Z infeed to the next machining pass. Oneway: Machining always in the same orientation. Zigzag: Machining with alternating orientation.

tips.title: Manage stock allowance for contour milling
tips.body: Stock allowance XY and Allowance (lateral infeed area) add up for 2D Contour Milling. Clearing open pockets: Use multiple horizontal stepovers.

tips.title: Control machining sequence for contour milling
tips.body: Bottom: Each contour fully processed with vertical stepdown. Plane: Stock allowance removed in multiple horizontal stepovers, followed by vertical stepdown.

tips.title: Smooth interior corners during contour milling
tips.body: Fillet interior corners: Smooth filleting of internal milling paths for contour pockets or islands. Reduce corner feedrate for sharp corners.

tips.title: Adjust feedrate based on contour direction
tips.body: For climb milling, use Auto climb option. For path compensation, select Left or Right tool position.

tips.title: Define plunge point for machining
tips.body: Enable 'End with plunge point' if a defined plunge point should be used for finishing.

tips.title: Select cutter type for contour milling
tips.body: Available cutter types include ball mill, end mill, and bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Define vertical milling area for contours
tips.body: Use 'Top of contour' or 'Bottom of contour' to set the machining limits relative to the selected frame.

tips.title: Set preferred start, end, and plunge points
tips.body: Select a point for each parameter or enable the checkbox to use default values.

tips.title: Adjust feedrate for individual contour segments
tips.body: Use 'Segments' option to assign a feedrate to specific areas of a contour.

tips.title: Optimize start points for closed contours
tips.body: Automatically search for the best starting points to avoid collisions.

tips.title: Define overlap length for closed contours
tips.body: Use 'Overlap length' to specify the distance beyond the start point.

tips.title: Align closed contours simultaneously
tips.body: Use 'Align closed contours' function to reverse machining direction for all selected contours.

tips.title: Connect adjacent contours
tips.body: Use 'Connect contours' function to link selected contours together.

tips.title: Adjust feedrate for zigzag infeed
tips.body: Use 'Zag feedrate (fact.)' to reduce the counter movement feedrate by a factor.

tips.title: Define machining sequence for contours
tips.body: Choose between 'Bottom', 'Plane', or 'Global plane' to define the processing order.

tips.title: Smooth filleting of internal corners
tips.body: Enable 'Fillet interior corners' to smooth the edges of contour pockets or islands.

tips.title: Reduce feedrate at interior corners
tips.body: Enable 'Reduce corner feedrate' to machine internal corners at a reduced speed.

tips.title: Use centre path for toolpath calculation
tips.body: Select centre path if your controller does not offer path compensation feature.

tips.title: Adjust vertical stepdown for consistent Z distances
tips.body: The value defined under Infeed for the vertical stepdown is automatically adjusted to ensure all Z distances are the same.

tips.title: Set fixed step for lateral infeed mode
tips.body: The value defined under Lateral infeed area for the lateral infeed is retained and automatically adjusted to the total infeed.

tips.title: Use finish only last level for final pass
tips.body: A finish pass is performed on the lowest level to ensure proper finishing.

tips.title: Enable spring path for closed contours
tips.body: An additional finish pass is performed for each Z level to remove fine machining cavities, increasing surface quality.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces to avoid tool contact with specific surfaces
tips.body: Specify the area of the CAD model on which no machining takes place.

tips.title: Use min trimming distance to avoid unwanted retract movements
tips.body: Enable to avoid unwanted retract movements if the section length is smaller than or equal to the min trimming distance.

tips.title: Define macro mode for tool approach and retraction
tips.body: Automatically or manually define the behaviour of the tool approach at the starting point and retraction from the end point of the contour.

tips.title: Extend contour for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Click Start to extend the contour by the specified amount for the approach movement, and Click End for the retract movement.

tips.title: Set macro position for manual mode
tips.body: Left or Right: The macro movement takes place to the left or right of the tool, from the perspective of the contour.

tips.title: Define feedrate macros for approach and retract
tips.body: The feedrate may be defined for both Approach and Retract.

tips.title: Define allowances for each area of the T-slot
tips.body: Allowances can be set separately for XY, top, and bottom areas.

tips.title: Select tool reference points for precise milling
tips.body: Options include disabling, using the tip, or using the disc top.

tips.title: Specify path of T-slot using contours
tips.body: Contours must be planar and closed for complete slot machining.

tips.title: Select tool position in reference to contour direction
tips.body: Options include auto climb, on contour, left, and right.

tips.title: Set cutting speed for T-slot machining
tips.body: Cutting speed can be adjusted manually or based on factors.

tips.title: Choose machining direction for T-slots
tips.body: Options include on contour, left, right, and reverse.

tips.title: Define axial infeed for T-slots
tips.body: Options include top to bottom, bottom to top, middle, and automatic adjustment.

tips.title: Set finish allowance for T-slots
tips.body: Values can be added to allowances for finishing cuts in different areas.

tips.title: Use spiral infeed for T-slots
tips.body: Option to execute a spiral infeed to the next machining plane.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for T-slots
tips.body: Retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance distance.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for T-slots
tips.body: Retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance plane.

tips.title: Trim toolpaths to stock for T-slots
tips.body: Use offset or keep tool down based on the defined stock.

tips.title: Define approach and retract movements
tips.body: Options include perpendicular, quarter circle, tangential, and half circle. Macro extension is available for quarter circles.

tips.title: Set tool position for Auto climb
tips.body: Left and Right parameters are not available for Auto climb tool position.

tips.title: Specify model for machining area
tips.body: Define the milling area required for the current job.

tips.title: Use temporary safety surfaces for additional surfaces
tips.body: Create temporary safety surfaces to avoid unnecessary rapid travel movements.

tips.title: Check tool for collision avoidance
tips.body: If Compensated centre path is enabled, use the offset contour for collision check.

tips.title: Define chamfer mode for machining strategies
tips.body: Chamfer mode includes Modelled chamfer and Deburr / chamfer sharp edges.

tips.title: Set chamfer height for Deburr / chamfer sharp edges
tips.body: Chamfer height specifies the number of infeeds when using Deburr / chamfer sharp edges.

tips.title: Define contour selection for inclined pocketing
tips.body: Several circular and/or rectangular pockets can be machined in one cycle.

tips.title: Set wall angle for inclined pockets
tips.body: Pocket wall incline angle can be defined or adopted from a pocket feature.

tips.title: Define machining mode for face milling
tips.body: Select machining direction based on the longest face dimension.

tips.title: Set infeed mode for face milling
tips.body: Options include zigzag direct, zigzag smooth, and oneway.

tips.title: Adjust overlap parameters for face milling
tips.body: Consider corner radius and fit step to improve cut division.

tips.title: Use Playback Milling for simple milling work
tips.body: Generate paths by moving the mouse over corresponding areas and specify settings like Z value, tool diameter, and fillet radius.

tips.title: Select cutter types for plunge milling
tips.body: Choose from ball mill, end mill, or bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Define infeed strategy for contouring
tips.body: Roughing uses tool reference point and toolpath, while finishing calculates directly on the contour.

tips.title: Set retract strategy for plunge milling
tips.body: Rapid retraction is the default, and options include linear or circular motion.

tips.title: Configure machining area and allowances
tips.body: Define start/end of grooving motion with Top and depth values, and set additional allowances for XY/Z directions.

tips.title: Use zigzag strategy for machining direction changes
tips.body: Change machining direction per section, following the shortest path with horizontal stepover at machining feedrate.

tips.title: Implement inclined plunging motion
tips.body: Achieve an inclined plunging motion by specifying the plunge angle.

tips.title: Ensure collision monitoring during 3D machining
tips.body: Collision models are part of the CAD model, and frame orientation limits milled surfaces.

tips.title: Define clearance plane for rapid movements
tips.body: Specify the clearance plane by right-clicking on the icon and selecting a point.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for infeed control
tips.body: Define the clearance distance to specify the distance from the toolpath to be milled.

tips.title: Adjust vertical stepdown for machining planes
tips.body: Set the vertical stepdown to determine the number of machining planes.

tips.title: Specify horizontal stepover for infeed width
tips.body: Set the horizontal stepover as a length dimension or factor of the tool diameter.

tips.title: Use climb milling for clockwise rotating tools
tips.body: Select climb milling or conventional milling based on the tool rotation direction.

tips.title: Define machining boundaries using closed curves
tips.body: Use Polylines, Splines, or Circles as closed curves for boundary definition.

tips.title: Set minimum distance between boundary and machining area
tips.body: Ensure the minimum distance is cutter radius + machining allowance to avoid nose-diving.

tips.title: Use milling surfaces to define machining area automatically
tips.body: Milling surfaces can be used to calculate a boundary automatically.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces to exclude machining areas
tips.body: Use stop surfaces to define the area of the CAD model on which no machining takes place.

tips.title: Exclude surfaces not used for milling as stop surfaces
tips.body: All other surfaces of the workpiece that are not used for milling are automatically defined as stop surfaces.

tips.title: Soft bounding for ball mills
tips.body: Machining continues until tool exceeds surface by blending factor (0.02-0.2 x tool radius)

tips.title: Boundary subdivision methods
tips.body: Methods include Toward, On top, Offset, Past, Contact, and Tolerance for defining machining areas

tips.title: Boundary projection in hyperMILL
tips.body: Allows projecting defined boundary in any direction for better area limitation or accessing difficult areas

tips.title: Approach and retract macros in hyperMILL
tips.body: Additional movements for approach and retract, executed without collision with neighbouring surfaces

tips.title: Plunge macro strategies in hyperMILL
tips.body: Axial, Helical, and Ramp plunge methods available for level-by-level machining cycles

tips.title: Profile-oriented machining in hyperMILL
tips.body: Linear movements along surface tangent for convex and closed contours

tips.title: Ramp macro for level-by-level machining
tips.body: Soft cutting along the path, suitable for tight areas with potential contour violations or collisions

tips.title: Return macros during alternating orientation machining
tips.body: Horizontal stepover via clearance distance or plane, activated approach and retract macro during each motion

tips.title: Macro simultaneous execution
tips.body: Approach and retract macros executed in direction of surface normals during machining

tips.title: Feedrate macros for approach and retract
tips.body: Define feedrate values for additional movements, default is Feedrate XY

tips.title: Stock model definition in hyperMILL
tips.body: Define required model and stock for machining operations

tips.title: Handling multiple allowances in machining area
tips.body: Allowances from different groups are considered during machining if function is enabled

tips.title: Create temporary safety surfaces
tips.body: To avoid unnecessary rapid travel movements during multi-axis machining.

tips.title: Generate stock model
tips.body: For subsequent machining tasks, ensuring accurate material removal.

tips.title: Undercut trimming
tips.body: Avoid unnecessary empty paths in undercut areas during multi-axis stock indexing.

tips.title: Enable tool check
tips.body: For collision avoidance with the CAD model during machining.

tips.title: Set clearance value for tool components
tips.body: To ensure a minimum distance between the model and the tool, recommended to be twice the required distance.

tips.title: Define stop/clip tolerance
tips.body: For collision-free movement during toolpath calculation.

tips.title: Avoid stock models undercut from frame Z direction and +Z direction
tips.body: Not supported in hyperMILL.

tips.title: Use Extend option for tool length calculation
tips.body: If a collision occurs during 5X machining, hyperMILL calculates a larger tool reach based on the defined tool reach.

tips.title: Use Reduce option for tool length calculation
tips.body: Calculates the shortest possible collision-free tool reach based on the defined tool reach.

tips.title: Display calculated tool length for reused tools
tips.body: After creating the toolpath file(s), select the tool in the browser and choose the usage function.

tips.title: Handle unresolvable collisions during machining strategies
tips.body: Options include Stop, Clip, Collision avoidance.

tips.title: Check for collisions in areas outside the stock
tips.body: Ensure a shroud surface is present to check for collisions.

tips.title: Check for collisions with tapered tools in 5X machining
tips.body: For strategies like Profile Finishing, Equidistant Finishing, and Rework Machining.

tips.title: Use Clip option for 3D Rework Machining
tips.body: Toolpaths calculated for the Clip option are used as the basis.

tips.title: Determine area for further machining in Rest Material Machining
tips.body: Area determined and graphically displayed within the cycle.

tips.title: Use Min. distance G0 for minor surface gaps
tips.body: To protect machine ramps against overstressing.

tips.title: Set Min. G0 distance for traversing small inside boundaries
tips.body: Distance between two machining areas that can be traversed without tool contact.

tips.title: Use ball mills, end mills, and bullnose end mills for Arbitrary Stock Roughing
tips.body: Core Diameter, Core Height, and Plunge Angle control plunge behavior.

tips.title: Handle center cut with core diameter and height values both set to 0
tips.body: Tool performs a centre cut.

tips.title: Consider corner radius for infeed distance with bullnose endmills
tips.body: Infeed distance based on the tool's inner shank to avoid material ridges.

tips.title: Use tapered tools
tips.body: Tapered tools are supported, with the cone angle defining the tool's shape.

tips.title: Select machining direction based on main extension
tips.body: Choose the machining direction to align with the main extension of the machining area.

tips.title: Tilt frame for inclined surfaces
tips.body: For inclined surfaces, tilt the current frame to achieve a vertical stepdown.

tips.title: Parallel contour machining with horizontal stepover
tips.body: Carry out machining parallel to the contour, executing vertical stepovers in the machining direction.

tips.title: Define machining area parameters
tips.body: Set allowance and additional allowance XY for different stock allowances in the X, Y, and Z directions.

tips.title: Enable max step height for large axial infeeds
tips.body: Use the Max. step height parameter to achieve continuous allowance despite large axial infeeds.

tips.title: Use automatic stepdown for planar surfaces
tips.body: Enable the Automatic option to automatically insert intermediate levels with smaller vertical stepdown values for planar surfaces.

tips.title: Optimize infeeds for smoother movements
tips.body: Use optimised infeeds with smooth, stretched infeeds between single equidistant cuts to reduce tool wear and tear.

tips.title: Enable minimal stock removal for collision avoidance
tips.body: Set the Minimal stock removal value to enable automatic collision avoidance and ensure continuous monitoring of the tool against tracked stock.

tips.title: Enable finish pass all levels for minor changes
tips.body: Use the Finish pass all levels option to ensure tool movement along the defined contour even if no material is cleared.

tips.title: Enable high performance roughing for constant load
tips.body: Use the High Performance Roughing option to achieve a constant load on the tool and machine during the entire machining sequence.

tips.title: Enable opening cut for narrow areas
tips.body: Use the Opening cut option to open narrow, inaccessible areas with several vertical stepdowns (full cut).

tips.title: Enable side mill only for narrow areas
tips.body: Use the Side mill only option to open narrow, inaccessible areas with trochoidal movements without full cut behavior.

tips.title: Set safety parameters for reposition
tips.body: Define the safety parameters for reposition, including axial movement and feedrate values.

tips.title: Set plunge feedrate for closed pockets
tips.body: Specify the minimum feedrate for plunge movements in closed pockets that cannot be accessed from the outside.

tips.title: Adjust entry feedrate for hard materials
tips.body: Use a targeted entry feedrate adjustment at the moment of entering material with hard workpiece materials.

tips.title: Use zigzag feedrate for climb milling
tips.body: For climb milling, reduce the opposite direction feedrate by a specified factor (e.g., 0.8) to achieve a 20% reduction.

tips.title: Define plunge points for High Performance Mode
tips.body: User-defined plunge points are available for High Performance Mode to ensure collision-free entry into material.

tips.title: Limitations in High Performance Mode
tips.body: In High Performance Mode, certain standard functions in the Arbitrary Stock Roughing cycle are limited or unavailable.

tips.title: Adjust feedrates dynamically during full cut
tips.body: For the opening cut, a separate feedrate can be defined to adjust dynamically based on machining conditions.

tips.title: Use helical or ramp plunge macro for plunges
tips.body: A complete helical or ramp movement always occurs for the plunge macro, with the angle reduced dynamically to create a complete path.

tips.title: Define pilot hole diameter and angle
tips.body: Specify the pilot hole diameter (at least 1.25* tool diameter or 1.1* tool diameter + 4* stock tolerance) and angle (corresponds to the tip angle of the tool being used).

tips.title: Limit machining area using groove limit
tips.body: Use groove limit to limit the machining area to grooves, which can be enabled or disabled.

tips.title: Define search width and min groove depth
tips.body: Specify the search width (areas narrower than this are machined) and min groove depth (areas lower than this are machined).

tips.title: Define plunge macro parameters
tips.body: For the plunge macro, specify Helix radius and Angle for helical movement or Angle for ramp movement.

tips.title: Use Optimised in plunge ramp direction
tips.body: When using the Optimised in machining strategy, define whether the tool moves synchronously with the model side or stock side during the first cut.

tips.title: Define machining tolerance
tips.body: Enter the required tolerance to define the accuracy of toolpath generation.

tips.title: Use G2/G3 output for circular arcs
tips.body: Circular arcs in the level are output as G2 or G3 commands if enabled; otherwise, all movements are output as G1 commands.

tips.title: Define minimum pocket size
tips.body: Set the minimum size for pockets that can be machined with a specific tool, default is 3.5 * tool radius.

tips.title: Stop before execution with toolpath markers
tips.body: A stop marker in the toolpath causes the tool to stop, ensuring safety during machining.

tips.title: Use minimum G0 distance for rapid movements
tips.body: Define the maximum distance between two machining surfaces to prevent unnecessary rapid movements.

tips.title: Enable Adaptive Pocket strategy for high-speed cutting
tips.body: With the Adaptive Pocket strategy, calculate highly efficient toolpaths for rectangular and circular pockets to achieve higher feedrates.

tips.title: Use free tip geometry for calculation
tips.body: Calculate toolpaths using a free tip geometry to optimally incline the area to be machined.

tips.title: Lateral infeed > 50% of tool diameter
tips.body: Example: lateral infeed: 22 mm, tool diameter: 35 mm

tips.title: Smooth rolling in at the start
tips.body: Radius for horizontal infeed: The horizontal infeed between the tool paths is rounded with this radius.

tips.title: Adaptive pocket strategy for roughing
tips.body: Each pocket to be machined is fitted into a maximum of one adaptive pocket.

tips.title: Fullcut max. stepdown parameter
tips.body: Limits the plunge angle of the tool as plunging is carried out in full cut.

tips.title: Reduce feedrate during full cut
tips.body: Machining is carried out using the reduced feedrate that is defined.

tips.title: Horizontal stepover factor
tips.body: Horizontal stepover as a factor of the milling tool diameter.

tips.title: Vertical stepdown for scallop height
tips.body: Only available for Adaptive Pocket machining jobs with automatic Plane level detection.

tips.title: Stock allowance for full cut
tips.body: Switch can be made from the defined horizontal stepover to full cut when calculating the toolpath.

tips.title: Additional chip thickness for stock removal
tips.body: Value in XY or Z direction by which the tool may damage the stock model.

tips.title: Auto option for plane level detection
tips.body: Insert an intermediate step with a smaller vertical stepdown value for the planar surfaces of the workpiece.

tips.title: Boundary mode for machining area limit
tips.body: Limit the machining area in the horizontal direction either in Curve selection mode or Surface selection mode.

tips.title: Toward option for machining ends
tips.body: Machining ends as soon as there is contact between the tool shank and the boundary.

tips.title: Skip option for unresolvable collision
tips.body: Preferred methods to avoid long calculation times for minimal stock removal.

tips.title: Clearance feedrate for linking movements
tips.body: (1) = G1 movement (material removal), (2) = G0 movement (rapid).

tips.title: Min. pocket size for tool
tips.body: Define the minimum size for pockets that can be machined with the specific tool.

tips.title: Use ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, or lollipop for Profile Finishing
tips.body: These cutter types can be used for collision-free milling with different guide curve strategies.

tips.title: Define infeed strategy for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Options include standard profiles, free profiles, ascending, descending, and zigzag direct/reverse.

tips.title: Use XY optimised finishing for fine finishing
tips.body: Automatically uses the opposite profile to finish inadequately machined areas.

tips.title: Set machining angle for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Enter the rotation angle required for machining based on guide curves.

tips.title: Adjust infeed direction for optimal machining paths
tips.body: Customise milling and infeed directions to adapt to the surface.

tips.title: Define guide curves for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Use any 2D or 3D curves and splines as guide curves, with options for open or closed curves.

tips.title: Set horizontal stepover for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Adjust the infeed direction based on the guide curves.

tips.title: Use offset area for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Define a positive or negative distance to the guide curve within which machining will take place.

tips.title: Define pocket profiles for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Closed 3D contours can be used as the profile, and one or more pocket profiles can be defined per cycle.

tips.title: Set cutting mode for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Adapt the cutting mode to the contour to be machined (climb or conventional milling).

tips.title: Define infeed direction for pre-machined contours
tips.body: Use Inside-out or Outside-in parameter to adapt the infeed direction.

tips.title: Set type of cut for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Options include ascending, descending, and up and down (standard method for finishing).

tips.title: Define infeed mode for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Options include zigzag direct, zigzag smooth, diagonal, and parallel.

tips.title: Enable slope mode for Profile Finishing
tips.body: Use from and to parameters to define the lower and upper limits of the surface slope.

tips.title: Enable smooth overlap for slope-dependent machining
tips.body: Smooth overlap ensures a very high level of surface quality in the transition area between flat and steep surfaces.

tips.title: Use vertical infeed mode for constant vertical stepdown
tips.body: Constant vertical stepdown allows the stepdown to take place with a fixed vertical increment.

tips.title: Define additional allowance XY for different stock allowances
tips.body: Additional allowance XY allows machining to take place with different stock allowances for the bottom and side walls of the machining area.

tips.title: Use constant on curve projection for improved surface quality
tips.body: Constant on curve projection projects a guide curve onto the surfaces and steps equally based on the specified infeed, improving surface quality.

tips.title: Limit machining area with boundary curves or milling surfaces
tips.body: Boundary curves or milling surfaces can be used to limit the machining area, with options for soft bounding and manual selection.

tips.title: Enable trimming to stock for toolpath optimization
tips.body: Trimming to stock allows the use of the stock to trim the toolpaths, optimizing the machining process.

tips.title: Define tool reference for edge behavior control
tips.body: Tool reference defines the edge behavior of the tool, including contact options and offset settings.

tips.title: Use approach and retract macros for controlled tool movements
tips.body: Approach and retract macros control the tool's movement during approach and retraction, avoiding collisions.

tips.title: Enable 3D path compensation for tool size adjustments
tips.body: 3D path compensation allows different NC programs to machine the model using a smaller or larger tool than is actually programmed in hyperMILL, retaining an allowance.

tips.title: Select appropriate cutter types for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: For Z constant finishing, ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, woodruff, and lollipop mills can be used, with exceptions for certain machining modes.

tips.title: Use plane machining sequence for level-by-level finishing
tips.body: Plane machining sequence carries out machining level by level, executing selected approach and retract macros in each Z-level.

tips.title: Use pocket machining sequence for contour pockets or islands
tips.body: Pocket machining sequence contours pockets or islands in sequence, executing selected approach and retract macros.

tips.title: Prefer spiral machining for continuous toolpaths
tips.body: Spiral machining performs in one continuous toolpath with a complete or approximate spiral-shaped vertical stepdown, macros only at start and end.

tips.title: Use ramp connect for level-by-level machining with filleted stepdown
tips.body: Ramp connect performs level-by-level machining with ramp-shaped, filleted stepdown between levels, closing the last toolpath.

tips.title: Use zigzag machining for alternating orientation
tips.body: Zigzag machining performs with alternating orientation, executing selected approach and retract macros.

tips.title: Set infeed mode for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Rapid: Rapid movement between levels; Direct (1): Shortest path at feedrate; Smooth (2): Filleted transition.

tips.title: Configure vertical infeed mode
tips.body: Constant stepdown: Fixed infeed depth; Scallop height: Pre-defined scallop height; Minimum/Maximum vertical stepdown: Limits distance between paths.

tips.title: Use path compensation for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Compensated path function may be used; Warning if Return macro disabled and compensated path enabled.

tips.title: Define plunge point for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Enable to define XY coordinates; Automatically finds the deepest point if not enabled.

tips.title: Configure boundary for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Define outside contours as machining boundaries; One or more boundaries allowed.

tips.title: Set approach and retract macros for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Automatic or Manual mode; Smooth, Length, Lateral/Axial clearance, Max. axial lift.

tips.title: Use feedrate macros for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Define feedrate for approach and retract macros; Use Feedrate XY if not defined.

tips.title: Configure return macro for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Horizontal stepover via clearance plane or distance; Macro simultaneous available in specific cycles.

tips.title: Enable stock model for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Use stockmodel if Trim to stock option enabled; Check tool and NC parameters required.

tips.title: Use 3D radius compensation for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Available for Ball mill tool type; Retains defined allowance; Max. compensation value should be no more than 10% of cutter diameter.

tips.title: Use ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, or lollipop tools for shape level finishing.
tips.body: These cutter types are suitable for creating smooth surfaces with a fine finish.

tips.title: Select bottom surfaces for shape offset mode to reduce retract movements.
tips.body: The selection should form a significantly larger area in the Job frame XY projection.

tips.title: Use axial sorting for better geometry and reduced empty paths.
tips.body: This strategy sorts areas like corners or pockets axially and machines consecutively.

tips.title: Enable smooth overlap for high surface quality in transition areas.
tips.body: This option allows tool-paths of flat and steep areas to overlap, ensuring a very high level of surface quality.

tips.title: Define the model geometry (milling area) to be machined.
tips.body: This step involves setting up the boundaries and defining the areas to be machined.

tips.title: Use ISO lines for exact machining of individual or less continuous surfaces.
tips.body: Milling paths follow the course of ISO lines (U, V) to ensure optimal adaptation to surface flow.

tips.title: Ensure surfaces meet without gaps for smooth ISO machining.
tips.body: Flowing transitions of the ISO lines are required at common edge curves between neighboring surfaces.

tips.title: Use global orientation for milling paths running crossways or parallel to the longest boundary curve.
tips.body: This strategy is suitable for surfaces with more than two adjacent faces.

tips.title: Define machining direction and infeed direction for ISO orientation strategy.
tips.body: The first milling path runs in the positive direction of the selected ISO parameter, and the first infeed movement is executed in the positive direction of the other ISO parameter.

tips.title: Use zigzag direct or smooth for machining with changing cutting mode.
tips.body: This option allows for continuous toolpath with a spiral-shaped vertical stepdown.

tips.title: Group toolpaths uniformly or symmetrically for better distribution.
tips.body: Uniform paths are distributed uniformly, while symmetric paths are divided symmetrically from the center of the face to be machined.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces and offsets for macros in Global orientation strategy.
tips.body: Stop surfaces are areas where no machining takes place, and offset extends the area excluded from machining by a specified value.

tips.title: Disable collision check for undercut machining
tips.body: Ensure that the option for generating NC files is disabled when performing undercut machining.

tips.title: Use ball mill, end mill, or bullnose end mill for Free Path Milling
tips.body: The following cutter types can be used: ball mill, end mill and bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Combine contours for Free Path Milling
tips.body: Several contours can be combined in one cycle if they meet the following conditions: machining with the same tool, the same frame orientation, the same approach and retraction strategies and the same cutter position.

tips.title: Set stock allowance for Free Path Milling
tips.body:
Stock allowance Z offset contour: Remaining stock allowance in the Z direction
Stock allowance XY: Remaining stock allowance in the X and Y direction for machining to the right or left of the contour.

tips.title: Use Trochoidal stepover for Free Path Milling
tips.body: Trochoidal stepover: Trochoidal stepover (in loops) takes place along the selected contour, which serves as a centre point path.

tips.title: Set machining depth for Free Path Milling
tips.body: Machining depth: Machining depth of the contour.

tips.title: Use Perpendicular approach/retract for Free Path Milling
tips.body: Perpendicular (1): The tool moves perpendicular to the contour.

tips.title: Enable Trim to stock for Plane Machining
tips.body: Trim to stock: Enable to use the stock to trim the toolpaths.

tips.title: Set Material height for Plane Machining
tips.body: Use the Material height parameter to set the height of the material to be removed.

tips.title: Use Bullnose end mill for Plane Machining
tips.body: The following cutter types can be used: ball mill, end mill and bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for Plane Machining
tips.body: Clearance distance: Distance to be defined to the toolpath to be milled.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for Plane Machining
tips.body: Clearance plane: Plane for rapid tool movements.

tips.title: Enable stock for Plane Machining
tips.body: Enable stock: Enable function to use the stock to trim the toolpaths.

tips.title: Set boundary for Plane Machining
tips.body: Use the Boundary option to set one or more boundaries in order to limit the machining area.

tips.title: Set plane selection for Plane Machining
tips.body: Use the Plane selection option to define the plane surfaces to be machined.

tips.title: Set tool reference for Plane Machining
tips.body: Available are: to (1), on (2), past (3). For detailed explanations on the border behaviour of the tool at the machining limits, see section Tool reference.

tips.title: Enable tool check for Plane Machining
tips.body: The tool check ensures that all of the components defined for the tool are protected from a possible collision with the CAD model on the basis of existing material.

tips.title: Set check tolerance for Plane Machining
tips.body: Check tolerance: Permissible violation of the model geometry. Factor of the tool radius.

tips.title: Set finish allowance for Complete Finishing
tips.body: Finish allowance: Material that is removed during a final finish pass.

tips.title: Set slope angle for Complete Finishing
tips.body: Slope angle: The delimitation of steep and flat areas is determined by the slope angle.

tips.title: Enable smooth overlap for Complete Finishing
tips.body: Smooth overlap: Only available for slope-dependent machining. Enable if you want the tool-paths of flat and steep areas to overlap.

tips.title: Use bullnose end mill for Complete Finishing
tips.body: The following cutter types can be used: ball mill, end mill and bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Use constant machining direction or zigzag mode for both steep and flat areas
tips.body: Constant machining direction: Always performs in the same direction. Zigzag mode: Alternates orientation with ramped connect.

tips.title: Set fillet radius to prevent excessive tool wrapping and high load
tips.body: Fillet radius should be less than or equal to the tool radius.

tips.title: Exclude surfaces to avoid machining certain areas
tips.body: Select areas in the model and exclude them from machining using the Exclude Surfaces function.

tips.title: Use approach and retract macros for smooth movements
tips.body: Define macros with options like Smooth, Length, Lateral/Axial clearance, and Max. axial lift.

tips.title: Set infeed parameters for constant infeed during equidistant finishing
tips.body: Use Equidistant strategy with Infeed set to a constant value.

tips.title: Adjust connect factor for smooth toolpath connections
tips.body: Connect factor determines the length and rounding of ramp-shaped transitions between planes.

tips.title: Use spiral infeed mode for high-speed milling
tips.body: Interpolate toolpaths to form a spiral-like movement.

tips.title: Define machining area for form pocket finishing
tips.body: Use Top and Depth to define the vertical machining area, and set a reference plane under the top.

tips.title: Set horizontal stepover to half the tool diameter
tips.body: Horizontal stepover should not exceed half the tool diameter for optimal machining.

tips.title: Define plunge point for single pocket machining
tips.body: Enter X and Y coordinates for the plunge point; Z coordinate is calculated automatically.

tips.title: Use boundary for machining boundaries
tips.body: Several independent boundaries are allowed, or maximum blank boundaries can be used if none defined.

tips.title: Select one infeed point per cycle above greatest machining depth
tips.body: Ensure the infeed point is positioned above the deepest point of the pocket for optimal machining.

tips.title: Use vertical plunge macro for infeed without stock removal
tips.body: Vertical plunge macro is suitable for operations where no material needs to be removed.

tips.title: Select appropriate cutter type for Pencil Milling
tips.body: Use ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, or lollipop for Pencil Milling operations.

tips.title: Ensure reference tool diameter is up to 20% greater than machining tool
tips.body: The reference tool should be larger than the machining tool by at least 20% for accurate groove recognition.

tips.title: Select appropriate cutting mode for Pencil Milling
tips.body: Choose between Climb milling and Conventional milling based on the machining area's slope dependency.

tips.title: Set machining depth for Pencil Milling
tips.body: Define the depth of grooves to be machined, ensuring it is less than or equal to the tool diameter.

tips.title: Use vertical plunge macro for Pencil Milling
tips.body: Vertical plunge macro is recommended for operations involving soft materials or pre-drilling.

tips.title: Select appropriate tool for Automatic Rest Machining
tips.body: Use ball mill, Lollipop, or Bullnose end mill for Automatic Rest Machining operations.

tips.title: Ensure cavity width does not exceed 1.8 times tool diameter
tips.body: To achieve tidy machining, the cavity width should be less than or equal to 1.8 times the tool diameter.

tips.title: Set cavity depth for Automatic Rest Machining
tips.body: Define the depth from which the machining mode switches to cavity mode based on the selected strategy.

tips.title: Set cavity depth based on machining mode
tips.body: For normal mode, set cavity depth to at least 1.5 for (1) or 3.5 for (2). For complete machining, use a bullnose end mill as a reference tool.

tips.title: Enable slope-dependent machining for all areas
tips.body: Set the machining mode to 'Slope dependent machining - All areas' to machine both steep and flat areas.

tips.title: Define slope angle for slope-dependent machining
tips.body: When slope-dependent machining is on, define a slope angle to distinguish between steep and flat areas.

tips.title: Use different machining strategies for flat and steep areas
tips.body: For flat areas, use 'Normal' or 'Parallel'. For steep areas, use 'Z-Level', 'Normal', or 'Parallel'.

tips.title: Enable infeed mode for smooth or direct motion
tips.body: Choose 'Smooth' for HSC loop shape or 'Direct' for shortest path with surface contact if necessary.

tips.title: Set maximum cutting depth for flat and steep areas
tips.body: For flat areas, set Max. cutting depth in XY direction. For steep areas, set it in Z direction.

tips.title: Define boundary for machining area
tips.body: Use Boundary curve or Milling surfaces strategies to define the area to be machined.

tips.title: Activate parallel sorting for shortened paths
tips.body: Enable parallel sorting if paths need to be shortened due to multiple boundaries or tool holder collisions.

tips.title: Use ball mill, end mill, or bullnose end mill for rework machining
tips.body: Select appropriate cutter types like ball mill, end mill, or bullnose end mill for rework machining.

tips.title: Consider conical shape for tapered tools during tool check
tips.body: When using tapered tools, account for the conical shape in path calculations during the tool check.

tips.title: Set resolution value for rest material area determination
tips.body: Adjust the resolution factor between 0.25 and 0.5 based on the type of rest material areas.

tips.title: Define additional surfaces for safety
tips.body: Use the Hub surface as an additional surface to prevent tool generation below the bottom plane.

tips.title: Define boundaries for machining
tips.body: Use the Boundary feature to limit the machining area until the tool axis is on top of the boundary.

tips.title: Adjust toolpath offset
tips.body: Offset the toolpath by entering a positive value to enlarge the boundary or a negative value to reduce it.

tips.title: Use stop surfaces for further machining area limitation
tips.body: Enter stop surfaces to limit the machining area further.

tips.title: Enable trim to stock for toolpath optimization
tips.body: Trim the toolpaths using the stock to optimize machining.

tips.title: Activate parallel sorting for Rework Machining
tips.body: Enable parallel sorting to combine interrupted paths into groups, useful after a parallel rest material strategy.

tips.title: Select machining mode for Rib/Groove Machining
tips.body: Choose between Climb milling and conventional milling modes.

tips.title: Specify surfaces for Steep only machining mode
tips.body: Define the slope angle to specify which surfaces should be machined in Steep only mode.

tips.title: Set machining sequence for Rib/Groove Machining
tips.body: Choose between Z-level and Pocket machining sequences.

tips.title: Set minimum stock removal for Rib/Groove Machining
tips.body: Specify the minimum material quantity that must be removed during machining.

tips.title: Use additional parameters for machining
tips.body: Utilize additional parameters such as Minimal stock removal, Bottom height, and Machining area.

tips.title: Enable stop before execution for macros
tips.body: Add a stop marker in the toolpath to cause the tool to stop.

tips.title: Set minimum G0 distance for macros
tips.body: Define the maximum distance between two machining surfaces to traverse without tool contact.

tips.title: Set machining depth for contours
tips.body: Specify the machining depth of the contour.

tips.title: Set stock allowance for contours
tips.body: Define the remaining stock allowance in the X and Y direction.

tips.title: Use Oneway machining for consistent orientation
tips.body: Always machine in the same orientation to avoid errors.

tips.title: Enable Z-smoothing for contour quality
tips.body: Use Z-smoothing to smooth toolpaths when insufficient contour quality is detected.

tips.title: Set total infeed for horizontal infeed mode
tips.body: Define the total infeed value under Lateral infeed area for horizontal infeed mode.

tips.title: Use Fit step for equal infeeds
tips.body: Automatically adjust all infeeds to be the same using the Fit step horizontal infeed mode.

tips.title: Enable Spring path for complete contour machining
tips.body: Machine the entire defined contour even if no more material will be cleared using the Spring path.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for retract movements
tips.body: Define the vertical retract movements to the next infeed at a height of the axial clearance.

tips.title: Use Production mode for rapid tool movements
tips.body: Rapid tool movements occur as the shortest possible link between infeed planes, minimizing empty paths.

tips.title: Define ramp height for approach movement
tips.body: Set the height of the ramp for the approach movement using the Approach macro.

tips.title: Adjust ramp angle for approach movement
tips.body: Set the angle of the ramp for the approach movement using the Approach macro.

tips.title: Set ramp length for approach movement
tips.body: Define the length of the ramp for the approach movement using the Approach macro.

tips.title: Use Perpendicular approach for retract movement
tips.body: Select the Perpendicular option for the retract movement in the Approach macro.

tips.title: Use Tangential approach for retract movement
tips.body: Select the Tangential option for the retract movement in the Approach macro.

tips.title: Use Circular approach for retract movement
tips.body: Select the Circular option for the retract movement in the Approach macro.

tips.title: Use Ramp approach for retract movement
tips.body: Select the Ramp option for the retract movement in the Approach macro.

tips.title: Set feedrate for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Define the feedrate for both approach and retract movements using the Feedrate macros.

tips.title: Use Macros normal to surfaces for approach and retract
tips.body: Execute the approach and retract macros in the direction of the surface normals.

tips.title: Select language for hyperMILL software
tips.body: Choose the relevant language from the Language section to switch the language for hyperMILL and auxiliary programs.

tips.title: Edit or delete registered applications
tips.body: Modify existing entries for programs that are registered for the currently active user.

tips.title: Use ReportDesigner for joblist-based documentation
tips.body: Prepare a report layout in the form of an XSL file using the ReportDesigner tool.

tips.title: Adjust report layout properties
tips.body: Change text properties such as font, size, bold/italic, colour, margins, borders and alignment for visible elements.

tips.title: Test report layout changes
tips.body: Generate an actual report using the modified report layout to test even small changes.

formulas.name: Various geometric parameters of the features
formulas.expression: Formula is defined based on specific feature types such as Simple Hole, Sink Hole, Free defined hole, pocket (for use in contour milling cycle), and planes.
